isArchived.description: Indicates if supplier is archived. Archiving suppliers is a feature that needs to be activated in Spendesk.

externalIds.description: IDs this supplier has in external systems (ERPs), one entry per system. Only present when `externalIds` is requested through `include`. Not to be confused with `accountPayable.externalId`, which is the external ID of the account payable rather than of the supplier itself.

externalId.description: ID of the supplier in the external system.

provider.description: The external system the ID belongs to (e.g. Netsuite, Xero).

source.description: Who recorded the mapping. `native_integration` means a native ERP sync owns it and keeps it up to date; `public_api` means it was set through the API.

accountPayable.description: Account payable assigned to the supplier (if exists)

id.description: Internal Spendesk ID of the account payable

generalAccountCode.description: Accounting code of the account payable

auxiliaryAccountCode.description: Auxiliary code of the account payable; empty string (never null) if unset

externalId.description: ERP ID of the account payable, if available; supplier ERP IDs: externalIds

line1.description: Full street address as free text

line2.description: Always null; street is in line1

country.description: Country as entered at supplier creation time

registrationNo.description: Tax registration number of the supplier

createdBy.description: Id of the user that created the supplier (If available)

updatedBy.description: Id of the user that updated the supplier (If available)

bic.description: Supplier's bank account BIC (for GET endpoints, backward compatibility)

iban.description: Supplier's bank account IBAN (for GET endpoints, backward compatibility)

bankCountry.description: Supplier's bank account ISO alpha-2 country code (for GET endpoints, backward compatibility)

bankDetailsUpdatedAt.description: Date and time when bank details were last updated (ISO 8601)

bankDetailsUpdatedBy.description: Id of the user who last updated the bank details

bankInfo.description: Bank information for the supplier (for POST/PATCH endpoints)

bankCountry.description: Country where the bank is located

dateTime.description: String containing a UTC datetime expressed in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format like `2023-05-12T14:06:40Z`.
dateTime.title: dateTime
